example.title: Broad Street, French Quarter, Charleston, SC (49451727813) (building 3 of the row)

brief: The right-hand building of the Broad Street row: a narrower three-storey front in red brick with a plain cornice and a real-estate office at street level. One photo. Older than 1970: the Charleston / New England main-street block is an 18th-19th-century type (the town's model). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
